current_behavior: Mutable process-global repositories/services are read directly by 43 feature/shared files
violated_future_rule: UI must depend on application commands/queries supplied by a scoped composition root
risk: Cloud/local hybrid, BusinessContext and session changes would require broad UI edits
recommended_migration_phase: 108E central application facade and dependency bundle skeleton

current_behavior: Presentation controller owns cross-repository sale, customer-ledger and financial-entry workflow via snapshots
violated_future_rule: One business command owns a non-UI logical transaction; server owns authoritative transaction
risk: Partial/double posting risk when infrastructure becomes remote or mixed

current_behavior: Repository implementation is both domain/application orchestrator and SQLite adapter across inventory, valuation, payable, cash and audit
violated_future_rule: Command handler owns orchestration; infrastructure adapter performs persistence only
risk: Cannot substitute cloud adapter without moving business workflow or duplicating it server-side
recommended_migration_phase: 108G extract purchase command boundary after first sale pattern

current_behavior: Mixed read/write repositories hide multi-ledger business commands and financial postings
violated_future_rule: Every financial mutation enters an explicit command handler with one transaction owner
risk: Cloud migration would expose dozens of repository verbs and client-side multi-step writes

current_behavior: Broad repository exposes low-level accounting entry creation to other client components
violated_future_rule: UI/application callers invoke use-case commands, never compose authoritative ledger writes
risk: Cloud clients could construct accounting postings or split invariants across calls
recommended_migration_phase: 108I introduce FinancialCommandGateway and server-operation-shaped local adapter

current_behavior: Global serialized snapshot rollback is the cross-repository safety mechanism; it is not one cloud/database transaction
violated_future_rule: Authoritative server operation owns atomic transaction; local provisional write and outbox intent are atomic
risk: Snapshots cannot guarantee remote atomicity, crash durability or exactly-once delivery
recommended_migration_phase: 108J freeze/implement UnitOfWork boundary and durable outbox

current_behavior: No authenticated business membership, businessId, role/version or tenant propagation object exists
violated_future_rule: businessId comes only from verified SessionContext/BusinessContext and is supplied to every command/query
risk: Tenant isolation cannot be safely added without manual leakage through screens/repositories
recommended_migration_phase: 108K implement SessionContext and BusinessContext boundary before cloud data adapters

current_behavior: O3 offline mutations have no durable command envelope/lifecycle/reconciliation store
violated_future_rule: Local provisional mutation and durable sync intent are atomically persisted
risk: Crash/retry may lose intent or double-post; provisional state cannot be reconciled

current_behavior: LocalReportRepository lazily captures repository instances on first access and cannot be rebound after an environment/business-scope change
violated_future_rule: Composition root must wire the final scoped graph and dispose/rebuild it explicitly
risk: Runtime adapter or business switching can leave reports bound to the previous graph; normal main ordering does not prove a current failure
recommended_migration_phase: 108L centralize query composition and remove immutable captures

current_behavior: UI layer directly constructs LocalThemeSettingsRepository and LocalBusinessIdentityRepository; identity repository also exists in AppRepositories
violated_future_rule: Only composition root constructs infrastructure; UI receives controllers/facades
risk: Duplicate lifetimes/state and future business scoping divergence
recommended_migration_phase: 108E move all app-scoped construction to root

current_behavior: Screens call write repositories directly
violated_future_rule: UI business mutation -> Application Command only
risk: Authorization/result/provisional semantics will diverge across entries

current_behavior: Screen invokes authoritative period mutations through repository
violated_future_rule: Close/reopen must be server-authoritative commands and never generic repository calls
risk: Stale balances or offline client could close/reopen incorrectly

current_behavior: Screen resolves and invokes activation workflow directly
violated_future_rule: UI must invoke explicit application command with stable result/provenance
risk: Activation controls future COGS behavior and requires authoritative transaction

current_behavior: Screen reaches application service through global locator and passes owner credentials
violated_future_rule: UI depends on command boundary/session re-auth capability; credentials never traverse generic business service in future
risk: Cloud auth/session and approval execution are tightly coupled to UI and local auth

current_behavior: Each mutation changes an in-memory superclass then rewrites full financial tables in a later SQLite transaction
violated_future_rule: Infrastructure adapter should apply command-scoped atomic persistence with concurrency/version checks
risk: Poor fit for multi-device authority; last-writer/concurrency and large rewrite risk

current_behavior: Price, stock, COGS, closing and approval rules live inside repository implementations
violated_future_rule: Domain rules are invoked by command handlers and share one authoritative implementation/contract
risk: Server migration risks duplicated/divergent rules
recommended_migration_phase: 108F preserve/extract sale domain policy behind handler; no behavior rewrite

current_behavior: Local machine file is licensing authority and evaluate mutates it at bootstrap
violated_future_rule: Licensing is server authoritative with explicit cached/grace contract
risk: Cannot bind license to user/business or resist copied local state
recommended_migration_phase: Post-boundary licensing phase before general cloud rollout

current_behavior: Dashboard combines direct repository reads and a screen-built service without one consistency token
violated_future_rule: Query result declares confirmed/cached/provisional provenance and asOf
risk: KPIs may mix data ages and provisional/confirmed values

current_behavior: Reports construct query services and read several repositories independently
violated_future_rule: Queries enter application query boundary with declared consistency mode
risk: Official reports can mix snapshots and cannot force one server read model

current_behavior: Most controllers combine query loading, command authorization, UI error strings and domain orchestration
violated_future_rule: Handlers return typed results/errors independent of Flutter; presentation adapts them
risk: Difficult headless/server reuse and inconsistent error mapping

current_behavior: Branding identity is treated like a global local setting, not business-scoped data
violated_future_rule: Business profile is obtained using verified BusinessContext
risk: Wrong branding/data could leak when multi-business sessions are introduced

current_behavior: Restore uses repository snapshots across many durable adapters and is exposed as local application operation
violated_future_rule: Backup is export/migration artifact; cloud import is a governed server job
risk: Treating restore as cloud authority could overwrite shared state
recommended_migration_phase: Dedicated migration/import phase; keep local behavior unchanged

current_behavior: Export services reach global business identity during rendering
violated_future_rule: Export query/result receives business profile snapshot and provenance
risk: Hidden global business scope prevents deterministic multi-tenant export

current_behavior: Several service getters construct a fresh object on every access without declared lifetime
violated_future_rule: Composition root declares singleton/session/business/request lifetimes
risk: Mostly testability/performance ambiguity, not immediate invariant failure

current_behavior: Unrelated provider bootstrap remains in main while future target discusses Supabase
violated_future_rule: Composition root names provider responsibilities explicitly
risk: Conceptual ambiguity only; no current data authority coupling found
recommended_migration_phase: Document now; revisit only in scoped provider phase
